question_text: A Ticket object has status initially "open". Describe selection in a method update_status(result) that sets status="resolved" for result="success", status="failed" for result="failure", and leaves it unchanged for other results.
adaptation_rationale: Retains method/selection reasoning; modifies existing objects and does not claim class-definition coverage.
solution: Test result against success and set self.status to resolved; otherwise test failure and set failed. Other results perform no status assignment.

marking_points.criterion: Correct success test and resolved assignment.
Correct failure test/failed assignment, preserving other cases.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
